title: Beacon staging verification prerequisites and limits
body: For Beacon staging verification, run `pnpm beacon:smoke-v2` only after all staging migrations have passed. Never use this staging verification command against production. Verification uses 3 workers, permits 2 retries, and has a 45 second timeout.
limitations: Applies only to Beacon staging verification in this project; these settings do not authorize production use.

title: Zephyr deployment preflight and environment-specific limits
body: Zephyr deployments require a passing preflight before any apply operation. Use only the command and limits specified for the named environment: staging uses `zx stage-apply` with 3 workers, 2 retries, and a 30 second timeout; production uses `zx prod-apply` with 1 worker, 0 retries, and a 90 second timeout.
limitations: Staging and production commands and limits are distinct and must not be interchanged.
No deployment settings are established for other environments.

title: Mercator export defaults and temporary invoice-only incident override
body: Mercator exports run `mc export --batch` only after the export preflight passes. Standard limits are 4 workers, 2 retries, and a 60 second timeout. Until 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z, invoice exports alone must instead use 1 worker and 0 retries; their timeout remains 60 seconds. Other export types retain standard limits. A dated incident restriction overrides defaults only within its stated period and export type. This combined hypothesis expires at 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z.
limitations: The incident override applies only to invoice exports until the exact stated expiration, not to other export types or indefinitely.
The combined hypothesis inherits the temporary source's expiration of 2026-10-25T15:02:15.097Z; the original standard-limit evidence remains long-retention.
